ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_rankgap_weighted_sigmoid_cost
ir.intuition: Shift from logistic-advantage loss to a rank-based paradigm that uses the sigmoid link on a rank gap signal weighted by a normalized cost gap to emphasize pairs with significant cost differences, encouraging the model to learn preferences guided by both rank and cost while softly regularizing the margin.
ir.pseudocode:
rank_gap = batch['delta_rank']
cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
weight = batch['weight']
log_prob_w = batch['log_prob_w']
log_prob_l = batch['log_prob_l']
norm_cost_gap = cost_gap / (max(abs(cost_gap)) + epsilon)
sigmoid_margin = sigmoid(beta * (rank_gap - (log_prob_w - log_prob_l)))
loss = mean(weight * norm_cost_gap * sigmoid_margin)
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch['weight']
    rank_gap = batch['delta_rank']
    cost_gap = batch['cost_gap']
    eps = 1e-8
    abs_cost_gap = ops.abs(cost_gap)
    max_abs_cost = ops.max(abs_cost_gap)
    max_abs_cost = ops.maximum(max_abs_cost, ops.ones_like(max_abs_cost) * eps)  # avoid div 0
    norm_cost_gap = ops.div(cost_gap, max_abs_cost)
    beta = float(extra.get('beta', 5.0))
    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)
    margin_arg = ops.sub(rank_gap, diff)
    sigmoid_margin = ops.sigmoid(ops.mul(beta, margin_arg))
    weighted_components = ops.mul(weight, ops.mul(norm_cost_gap, sigmoid_margin))
    loss = ops.mean(weighted_components)
    return loss
